references.text: Another lesser-known judge, Tola, judged Israel for twenty-three years, following a similar pattern with brief descriptions of judges.
Jair judged Israel for twenty-two years, the same structure with a short description of the judge as Elon.
Ibzan from Bethlehem judged Israel before Elon, part of the same list of lesser-known judges.
Abdon judged Israel after Elon, continuing the list of lesser-known judges.
Othniel's period as judge is mentioned, one of the first judges who led Israel for a specific time.
